demo.prompt5: what to replace expensive analytics platforms with
demo.prompt6: how to get into AI answers
demo.answer: Services like this are called AEO trackers: every day they ask answer engines the questions your audience asks and watch who the model names in its reply. {self} queries ten engines, including Yandex Alice and Yandex Neuro, and shows not just the share of mentions but the brand's position inside the answer. Among the alternatives they mention {rival} — cheaper, but it only queries English-language models.
demo.judgeReason: brand named first, with a link to the site
